basis.owner_decision: Do not use WFA as the method for evolving the 27 fixture alpha candidates; perform one full-history run per candidate.

evaluation.run_definition: Submit one custom_backtest over start/end with no test_start; report metrics.simulate and series.stages.all as the full-span result. Any internal train/test breakdown is descriptive only and is not WFA.
evaluation.run_policy: One serial full-history run per candidate and one per unique parent template; no folds, no parameter tuning, no reruns to force a positive result.
evaluation.interpretation: Descriptive historical results only. The history has already been viewed and is not an untouched holdout. A positive return is not a WFA pass, robustness claim, profitability guarantee, or live authorization.

resource_limit: Keep EDU at 2 GB per job.
prohibitions: Do not modify or promote any original alpha record.
Do not launch a live or testnet bot.
Do not use WFA for this 27-alpha batch.
Do not call a positive full-history result a validated pass.
Do not add unapproved variants or tune repeatedly against the viewed history.
